recommendations.title: Microdochium patch risk is high
recommendations.message: Modelled risk is 3/4 — temperature and recent rainfall/leaf wetness both favour the UK's most common turf disease. Check closely for small, orange-brown patches, especially in shaded or slow-draining areas, and consider a preventative fungicide or cultural intervention (brushing off dew, improving airflow).

recommendations.title: Dollar spot risk is building
recommendations.message: Modelled risk is 16%, approaching the 20% threshold. Reduce leaf wetness duration where you can (mow or brush off dew early, avoid evening irrigation) and monitor daily.

recommendations.title: Topsoil is saturated
recommendations.message: Modelled topsoil moisture is 44%. Avoid mowing, rolling or heavy foot traffic until it drains, to prevent compaction and surface damage.

recommendations.title: Soil temperature suits seeding, but moisture doesn't
recommendations.message: Soil temperature is 8.8°C (good for germination) but topsoil moisture is currently saturated — irrigate or let it drain before seeding.

recommendations.title: Dew expected tomorrow morning — remove it early
recommendations.message: Forecast temperature and dew point are within 0.1°C of each other in the early hours, so a heavy dew is likely — and microdochium risk is already 3/4. Switching, brushing or an early mow to knock dew off is the single most effective cultural control while disease pressure is elevated.

recommendations.title: Keep mowers and rollers off today
recommendations.message: The surface is likely too wet for machinery (topsoil moisture is 44%). Mowing or rolling wet turf risks rutting, scalping and compaction — and wet clippings spread fungal disease. Wait for it to dry or drain.

recommendations.title: Water balance is in a healthy range
recommendations.message: 7-day net balance is +3mm — no irrigation action needed today.

recommendations.title: Conditions suit spraying today
recommendations.message: Wind is forecast at up to 12 km/h, within the typical safe spraying range. Always confirm against the product label and LERAP/buffer-zone requirements.

recommendations.title: Nitrogen guidance (growth-potential scaled)
recommendations.message: Average growth potential over the last 30 days is 36%, suggesting roughly 9 kg N/ha this month (= 36% of the 25 kg/ha peak-growth ceiling). Feed only what growth can use — and if the site is in a Nitrate Vulnerable Zone, check the closed-period panel on the dashboard before applying manufactured nitrogen.
